display_information.name: Brissa
display_information.description: Reads the messages you cannot, privately.
display_information.long_description: Brissa translates the messages you cannot read, privately and in place. It stays silent unless a message contains a language you do not read, and when it speaks, only you see it. The original is never edited and nobody else is told.

shortcuts.name: Translate for me
shortcuts.description: Read this message in your own language. Only you see it.

slash_commands.description: Translate recent messages here. Only you see the answer.
Enrol yourself: which languages you read, in order. Only you see the answer.
